name: Musigny
rightsHistoryPurpose: Official filiation, dated legal-entity rights and original-reference evidence for Musigny (#461). None establishes current farming.

reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The measured 491.630167 m² remainder (0.4519%) was reviewed against the pinned INAO boundary and Chambolle-Musigny and Morey-Saint-Denis cadastres. The cru outline has five separate parts; the remainder is narrow strips between the official line and the nearest cadastral parcels. It forms 10 pieces, with mean widths of 0.13–1.09 m for those of at least 1 m². All of it lies along the outline edge. It is not a missing INAO commune. Neighbouring Vougeot parcels account for 1.719153 m² of it. 489.911014 m² is covered by no audited parcel. No geometry is added, clipped, buffered or filled. The absolute cap allows less than 0.1 m² above this reviewed measurement; changed source hashes require another review.

namedPlots.coverageNote: Les Musigny and Les Petits Musigny are cadastral named areas within Musigny. The official list also names La Combe d'Orveau, but no cadastral lieu-dit covers the cru's south-western part, so that part keeps the whole-cru outline. Outlines follow the cadastre inside the official boundary, with small gaps retained; they do not show producer holdings.

unresolved.name: La Combe d'Orveau
unresolved.reason: The official list names La Combe d'Orveau, but the pinned lieux-dits cover none of the cru's 0.77 ha south-western part, and the cadastral COMBE D'ORVEAU lieu-dit lies about 477 m outside the cru. The seven parcels there are listed in parcelsWithoutLieuDit and keep no cadastral name. Do not infer this identity from proximity or fill the gap.

neighbouringLieuxDits.reason: Not an official Musigny climat. It holds most of parcels that only touch the cru edge; they stay cru parcels for rights and history, with no named area.
